Command.Statement: with set __XLSlice0 as { [Store].[All Stores] } set __XLExistingMembers as NonEmpty([Product].[Product Family].allmembers, __XLSlice0) set __XLExistingRangeMembers as SubSet(__XLExistingMembers, 0, 1000) set __XLNonExistingRangeMembers as Iif(__XLExistingRangeMembers.Count = 1000, {}, SubSet(Except([Product].[Product Family].allmembers, __XLExistingMembers), iif(0 - __XLExistingMembers.Count < 0, 0, 0 - __XLExistingMembers.Count), 1000)) member [Measures].__XLRelated as Intersect([Product].currentmember, __XLExistingRangeMembers).Count set __XLTargetSet as SubSet(Union(__XLExistingRangeMembers, __XLNonExistingRangeMembers), 0, 1000) select { [Measures].__XLRelated } on 0, __XLTargetSet on 1 from [ZFMSALES] cell properties value
